memory_update.text: POWL should be tracked as an underfollowed AI data-center electrical bottleneck supplier because it disclosed a $400M-plus data-center order tied to behind-the-meter on-site generation assets.
MOD should be tracked as a cooling-capacity beneficiary because it announced a $4B through-2029 Airedale data-center cooling capacity agreement with a strategic customer.

IESC should be tracked as a lower-attention electrical/infrastructure services beneficiary because its fiscal Q2 2026 Infrastructure Solutions growth was primarily driven by data-center end-market demand.

The node appears investable through multiple chokepoint subnodes: switchgear and behind-the-meter electrical systems, cooling capacity, custom engineered electrical infrastructure, and reference end-to-end power/cooling platforms.

Transformer pure plays remain a gap in the US-listed universe; Hammond Power Solutions has strong transformer/data-center evidence but is Canadian-listed/OTC rather than a clean US-listed common-equity candidate for this pass.

node: AI data-center power, cooling, switchgear, transformers, substations, and grid interconnection
summary: Expanded the node universe toward physical AI data-center infrastructure rather than GPUs or software. The highest-quality underfollowed lane candidates found in this pass are Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and behind-the-meter electrical systems, Modine for data-center cooling capacity, and IES Holdings for custom engineered electrical/infrastructure solutions tied to data-center projects. Vertiv remains the reference anchor because it is the obvious large-scale power-and-cooling leader, but its market attention and market cap make it less suitable for the underfollowed lane.
